IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Honeyford, Brandland, Roach, Sheahan, Mulliken and Rasmussen

Bill.BriefDescription: Suspending business and occupation taxation on certain businesses impacted by the ban on American beef products.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to suspending business and occupation taxation oncertain businesses impacted by the ban on American beef products;adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Until the department of revenue determines that Japan, Mexico,and the Republic of Korea have lifted bans on the importation of beefand beef products from the United States, the tax under RCW82.04.260(4) shall not be imposed. (2) The department of revenue shall provide notice of thereimposition of this tax to affected taxpayers, the legislature, andothers as deemed appropriate by the department.
